ledger.note: 180: the last dated trace. 'The Historia Augusta places the Hermunduri in an alliance with the Marcomanni, Sarmatians, and Quadi against Rome during the Marcomannic Wars' (180 AD); the Laterculus Veronensis lists the 'Hermundubi' in the 3rd century, and from the 5th century the Thuringii 'appear further north', speculatively linked to them (recent linguistics is critical). The end is a bridge.

notes: A state Cliopatria lacks, written because the marcomanni (19, 51), quadi (50) and chatti (58) dossiers name 'Hermunduri' as counterpart; Domitian's Chattian war also had the Hermunduri as allies (roman-empire dossier). One page opened (page budget). The page gives no area, no kings besides Vibilius, no capital, no Roman client dates (it has Tacitus's c. 100 description 'a people loyal to Rome'); the Chatti war is dated 57 here and 58 on the Chatti page. The extent is a reading; the 19 and 51 Bohemian events are bridges (confidence 1) mirrored in the marcomanni dossier. Wikidata id unknown. The Thuringii (Cliopatria's Kingdom of Thuringia from 476) are only speculatively descended. Reviewer eu-04-x (2026-10-19): the predecessor link to marcomanni was removed and the found counterpart set to nobody, because the Marcomanni had left the Main region before the marcomanni dossier begins (-9) and never hold it in their ledger.
